goal: untouched final evaluation set for push_T one-step joint-action prediction (R8)

splits.rule: episode-level, disjoint; dev chosen by seeded hash of file name

metrics_primary: physical L1 over 14 joint dims (frame mean, then episode macro)

baselines.train_affine: per-dim affine [S,V] -> delta fitted on TRAIN only
baselines.mlp_42d_R: MLP 42-128-128-14, [S,V,Acc] -> R, reported per seed and as a mean

gates.g1_l1_below_copyV: mean L1 < copy-V on the frozen final split
gates.g5_no_channel_regression: no arm-joint dimension worse than copy-V; grippers use the DEV policy

reporting.single_evaluation: the frozen set is evaluated once per model revision; no re-tuning on it
must_report: git SHA of the evaluated code
prohibited: reusing the old 20 holdout as the final claim

steps: build a manifest over the new data directory
commit the manifest and this protocol
run 'freeze' with the current git SHA and commit the frozen file BEFORE any model sees the data
verify the manifest again immediately before evaluation

coverage_targets_from_existing_set.note: the new set must span at least this range; object initial pose is only observable in the images, so diversity is checked via image hashes plus initial EE pose spread
